answer.rationale: memory_86 and memory_31 are most strongly supported for sustainable long-term qualified revenue: they directly address activation and onboarding completion—foundational metrics that predict retention and lifetime value. memory_91 similarly targets early engagement, a critical predictor of long-term viability. memory_44 shows enterprise conversion lift through sales-assisted flows, supporting quality revenue but lacks retention/LTV data. memory_73 and memory_57 are weakest: promotional pricing (memory_73) may attract price-sensitive accounts with lower retention and higher churn risk, directly undermining sustainability; referral incentives (memory_57) add revenue but explicitly note only "no measurable harm" to retention rather than proving durability, and rely on established customers who may have different economics than new cohorts. Neither demonstrates sustainable long-term value creation.
